reviews.report:
Primary Codex /root review of frozen source 762a4c0496d75ed1f5ab9f1a61cecb5823c59f6b for PR991 under the existing explicit sole-owner staging authorization. This is an attributed primary agent review, not another person's approval. Deployed source 8c41b6a8f54c6e1ff1e4e5f8ca0ba24256955ee7 admits the native dashboard and rejects foreign intake members without writes, but its own intake fails before persistence because canonical Django audit identifiers have no database defaults. Read-only deployed metadata also confirms required claim identifiers, timestamps, booleans and state values whose Django defaults execute in Python.

The canonical audit writer now supplies independent UUIDs for id and audit_id while retaining its advisory lock, Python-compatible content hash, tenant context and transaction. The NAR SQL regression fixture now requires both identifiers and timestamps without SQL defaults. Real signatures, tamper rejection, tenant restrictions and atomic rollback still pass. Drizzle claim fields provide runtime UUID/timestamp/boolean/state defaults while their existing SQL declarations are retained; history timestamps receive the same runtime fallback. A real PGlite fixture uses the deployed column types/nullability/defaults without business data. Explicit caller values are preserved. No migration, grant, auth permission, dependency, backend source or production configuration changes.

The three governance files authorize only PR991, exact branch fix/ue-native-write-defaults-20261022, actual author anungisa, merged base 8c41b6a8f54c6e1ff1e4e5f8ca0ba24256955ee7, and twelve exact source/test/inventory paths. The unchanged pinned Ed25519 trust key must verify a genuine domain-separated signature. Complete paginated API coverage, exact base/source blobs and hashes, unchanged trust bytes, sole-parent two-file evidence-only commit, source tree binding, expiry, primary attribution and head-race protections remain enforced. Existing PR984/986/990 rules remain intact. No human security-team label is synthesized.

All 169 verifier regressions and 27 targeted SQL/application regressions pass. No unresolved P0/P1 was identified within this bounded source review. Full required repository checks and exact final-head protected CI remain pending and mandatory before review readiness or normal merge. This does not claim the application fix deployed, staging GO, independent human approval or production authorization. Fresh merged-source images, signed clone qualification and actual native staging acceptance remain required.
